description: This file contains the implementation of the SearchScreen composable in a Jetpack Compose Android app, including UI components for search input, recent searches, search results, and related interactions.

methods.name: SearchScreen
methods.description: Main composable function displaying the search UI, including toolbar, results, and recent searches.

methods.name: EmptySearchResultBody
methods.description: Displays a message when no search results are found, with a link to interests.

methods.name: SearchNotReadyBody
methods.description: Displays a message indicating the search API is not ready.

methods.name: SearchResultBody
methods.description: Displays search results including topics and news resources in a staggered grid.

methods.name: RecentSearchesBody
methods.description: Displays a list of recent search queries with an option to clear them.

methods.name: SearchToolbar
methods.description: Top toolbar with back button and search input field.

methods.name: SearchTextField
methods.description: Input field for entering search queries with icons and keyboard handling.
